protocol.target: source building of a completed daily electrical profile
protocol.test_rule: last 20% of eligible distinct dates; all buildings share each date's partition
protocol.cv: 3 expanding chronological folds, each with seven calendar days purged before validation
protocol.selection: highest mean validation macro F1; ties follow fixed candidate order
protocol.predictors: power and signed power factor summaries only
protocol.test_policy: select and serialize the development-fitted model before one final test evaluation; no refit on test
